mentions.name: The Password App
mentions.description: This is an AI-powered macOS desktop app that automatically rotates passwords across websites. It imports a CSV from existing password managers (1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden), lets the user select which accounts to update, and uses AI-driven browser automation with Gemini 2.5 Flash (via the browser-use library) to navigate to each site's password change page and update passwords in parallel, then exports a CSV with the new passwords to import back. A local-only architecture keeps passwords off the cloud: everything stays in memory and is cleared after use, credentials are never logged, sent to the LLM context, or persisted on disk, and a custom fork of browser-use injects credentials via secure parameters invisible to the AI agent. Technically it pairs an Electron + React frontend with a Python agent for browser automation over stdio IPC, using OpenRouter for LLM access (Gemini for navigation, Grok for validation). Currently at v0.38 with macOS code signing and notarization; ongoing work focuses on improving success rates against 2FA requirements and anti-bot detection (Cloudflare, reCAPTCHA).
mentions.problem: Most people have 100+ accounts with weak or reused passwords, and changing them manually is tedious so nobody does it.
